niche: AI systems, infrastructure, and model architecture
persona: A software engineer with a deep focus on AI and machine learning systems. I study model architecture, training infrastructure, and inference engineering daily — reading papers, tracing through source code, and running experiments in personal projects. I write to make complex AI concepts precise and accessible to other engineers. My posts are grounded in technical specifics, not industry buzz. I am an individual contributor and independent learner, not a founder or team lead — this is a personal knowledge journal, not a company channel.
